name: Reschedule with Vague Info
watch_for: Does it ask clarifying questions, or invent an appointment?
Does it actually look the appointment up?
Does it confirm the new details clearly?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Thanks for calling PivotPoint Orthodontics. Part of Pretty Good AI. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Hi, I have an appointment this week I need to move. I think it's Thursday? Maybe Wednesday?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file. I speaking with Sarah?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Yeah, that's me. Sarah Johnson.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Please provide your date of birth.

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Sure, it's March fifteenth, nineteen eighty-nine.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: You have an appointment

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: scheduled for Thursday, August 20 at 09:45AM with Abreger at Nashville 220 Athens Way.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Is this the appointment you want to move?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Oh, Thursday — wait, I thought it was at like two or three in the afternoon? Nine forty-five in the morning?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Yes. Your appointment is at 09:45 in the morning. Would you like to reschedule this appointment to a different time or day?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Yeah, can we move it to next Monday?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: I have openings on Monday, August 24. At 9AM, 09:45AM, and 10:30AM.

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Is there anything before nine? Like eight or eight thirty?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Do any of these times work for you, or would you prefer a different time of day?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Uh, is eight thirty not available at all?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: There are no openings before 9AM on Monday. The earliest available is 9AM. You like to take that or try a different day or time?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Okay, let's do nine AM then. But wait — will I see the same doctor, or will it be someone else?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: You will see the same provider, Abricker, at the Nashville location. Before I reschedule, can you tell me the reason you need to move your appointment?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Oh, I just have a conflict on Thursday. So that nine AM Monday — is that confirmed with the same doctor?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Yes. It will be with Abrekar on Monday, August 24 at 9AM. Would you like me to reschedule your appointment to this new time?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Yes please. And — sorry, can you just read that back to me one more time?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: You'll be rescheduled to Monday, August 24 at 9AM with Abrekar at Nashville. 220 Athens Way.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Please bring a photo ID and your insurance card to your appointment. Is everything correct?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: So that's Monday August twenty-fourth at nine fifteen AM, right?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: It's actually Monday, August 24 at 9AM, not 09:15. You like to confirm this time?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Oh right, nine AM — yes, that works. So that's confirmed?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: Yes. Your appointment is confirmed for Monday, August 24 at 9AM with Abreker at Nashville.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: 220 Athens Way. Would you like a text message with these details?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Yes please, that'd be great. Um, one more thing — do you know what my copay will be?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: I've sent the appointment details to your phone. For your CO OP amount, I recommend checking with your insurance provider, or you can ask at the front desk when you arrive.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: There anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Even just a ballpark? Like is it usually around twenty, thirty dollars?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: I don't have access to your specific co pay amount. Most co pays for orthopedic visits are typically between 20 and $50.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: But it depends on your insurance plan. The front desk can confirm the exact amount when you check-in.

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Okay, that helps. And actually, I'm not totally sure if my Aetna or my husband's United Healthcare is the active one right now — does it matter which one I bring?

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: It's important to bring your most current insurance card. If you're unsure which is active, bring both Aetna and UnitedHealthcare cards.

turns.speaker: AGENT (Pretty Good AI)
turns.text: The front desk can help verify which one is on file and update it if needed. Would you like to update your insurance information now?

turns.speaker: PATIENT (our bot)
turns.text: Um, I'm not sure which one to put down, so maybe I'll just bring both and sort it out there. That works?
